name: Gansu Guofang Industry & Trade (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Gansu Guofang Industry & Trade (Group) Co., Ltd. engages in the chain retail business in China. The company operates department stores under the Dongfanghong Plaza Store, Baiyin World Trade Center Store, Ningxia Shopping Plaza Store, Zhangye Shopping Plaza Store, Xining Guofang Department Store, Guofang G99 Shopping Center, and Jinchang Guofang Department Store; supermarkets under the Zongchao Plaza Store, Zongchao Xihuayuan Store, Zongchao Qilihe Store, and Zongchao Store Gaolan store names; and electrical appliance stores under the Guofang Electric Appliances brand. It is also involved in real estate leasing business. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Lanzhou, China.
